title: Urology and Continence Supply Program: addition to the hardship waiver share for older postings
content:
On the Urology and Continence Supply Program, a hardship waiver for a posting that has stood unpaid for some time receives an addition to its waiver share. The addition is set by the age of the posting named on the approved hardship application.

## Clause

- When the named posting is dated more than 180 calendar days before the waiver date, 0.15 is added to the waiver share.
- When it is dated more than 90 but no more than 180 days before, 0.10 is added.
- Otherwise nothing is added.

## Boundaries (hypothetical posting ages on the waiver date)

| Named posting dated before the waiver date | Addition |
|---|---|
| 90 days | none |
| 91 days | 0.10 |
| 180 days | 0.10 |
| 181 days | 0.15 |

*Hypothetical arithmetic:* a waiver share of one half with an addition of 0.15 becomes 0.65.
